body: ACK CURRENT ARTIFACT. I have no open objection to draft-3-as-amended: C1-C5 and R1-R11 are ready for chief disposition; R12 is ADR-required subject declaration, not buildable as drafted; Q-A remains open model research with Q-A1/Q-A2 standing; Q-B gates calibrated acceptance, not specification. My durability condition remains: the filed PRD must materialize the complete contract in one self-contained bundle rather than require reconstruction from superseded posts. No implementation or authority claimed.
